_comment: uni-lab.local NAME MAP (ADR-PROD-013 + the DNS/observability plan). The ONLY declared data — the observability backend reads everything else LIVE and diffs against this. NV = not-verified live in the survey; the name is correct, must not render green until its live probe passes.
_lan_dynamic_law: A service carrying "lan": "dynamic" sits on the chip, whose LAN address is a DHCP lease on a disposable uplink (docs/handoffs/ADAPTIVE_SELF_NETWORK_HANDOFF_2026-07-15.md). Its LAN address is NOT DECLARABLE and MUST NOT be written here — on 2026-07-16 the lease moved .122 -> .121 and every hand-declared literal went stale in place, pointing the Door's hrefs and Gaia's colony collectors at a dead host while the colony was demonstrably LIVE. DNS (uni-dns on the chip, which the chip keeps current) is the authority; viewer/host_resolve.cjs resolves the name on demand and every consumer follows automatically. "ips" therefore lists STABLE planes ONLY (mesh 10.13.13.x / overlay 100.x, which do not move) and is legitimately EMPTY for a chip service that has no stable plane. Probes address services BY NAME. Never re-add a LAN literal for a dynamic service — that re-arms the exact trap this law exists to disarm.

resolver.kind: dnsmasq 2.91 — LIVE and authoritative for uni-lab.local on the chip :53 since 2026-07-12 (receipt production/docs/receipts/dns_phase0_4_2026-07-12.md). Read '(planned)' here until 2026-07-26, fourteen days after it went into production.
resolver.authoritative_lan: dynamic — the chip's LAN A record for its own resolver; reach it by name (dns.uni-lab.local) or over the stable mesh 10.13.13.1. The DNS-bootstrap literal (the one place a current LAN IP may live, per CLAUDE.md) is viewer/infra.cjs:314.
resolver.mdns_foundation: avahi is present but does NOT serve this zone — mDNS is multicast 224.0.0.251:5353 and cannot answer the unicast queries dnsmasq answers, nor resolve podman containers (production/dns/README.md, first paragraph). This field claimed avahi served the zone until 2026-07-26; it did not.

_goLiveGate_note: This is the FALLBACK entry. The panel derives the real gate LIVE from probes: goLiveGate.plumbing = (node2 tcp probe up) && (colony /producer/health verdict=LIVE, driver=producer) && (verify_overlays exit 0) && (verify_colony PASS). goLiveGate.colony_on_program = (forage-pureworld-graduation gate row in evidence/gates.ndjson verdict==PASS). Colony scene stays OFF program until colony_on_program flips.

services.name: gaia
services._probe_note: HONESTY FIX 2026-07-16 (3rd instance of ONE defect class in one day). Was path=/api/gaia with NO timeout, so infra.cjs's `|| 2000` default applied -- against an endpoint measured at 6.3s-20s. It could NEVER pass: Gaia's /infra row was PERMANENTLY red while she served 200s. An alarm that is always on is not an alarm: hours of a red panel train the eye to ignore it, so a REAL Gaia outage becomes invisible. Worse, /api/gaia is her FULL envelope -- every seat route computes all ~174 signals before filtering (gaia_server.cjs:150) -- so merely PROBING it forced a ~20s/611KB collector run on EVERY infra poll, the exact overlapping load her single-flight coalescing exists to damp. Fixed both halves: probe a cheap route (/api/gaia/snapshots = read-only capture index, measured 5ms, computes no envelope) with a real declared timeout. Siblings fixed same day: launcher.cjs /api/status (3000ms vs envelope) and the HUD's gaia_drift upstream (8000ms vs envelope). THE RULE: never aim a probe at Gaia's envelope. Probe liveness cheaply; read her VERDICT from her own gate (node viewer/gaia/verify_gaia.cjs), never infer it from a timeout.

services._ips_note: STABLE PLANES ONLY, per the _lan_dynamic_law: the chip's LAN address is a DHCP lease and is NEVER declared. Overlay (tailscale 100.100.188.48) is FIRST because host_resolve's declaredStable() takes ips[0] and THINKER is on the tailnet (100.98.223.27) — measured 2026-07-16: http://100.100.188.48:8687/healthz -> 200, while the wg mesh 10.13.13.1 is NOT reachable from THINKER (THINKER is not a mesh peer). So the overlay plane is the honest fallback that actually works from here. DNS still WINS when music.uni-lab.local resolves (host_resolve tries getaddrinfo first); this is the fallback for the window before the zone gains the record.
services._probe_note: Probe /healthz — measured 4 bytes 'ok' in ~5ms. DO NOT probe /api/tracks (~200KB) or /radio (endless MP3) or /api/nowplaying (session-tied). NEVER probe the FULL envelope on any Gaia-like service; the honesty class here is the same rule applied to a music service.
